name: Palace
tagline: Also known as Shithead. Get rid of every card — don't be the last one holding them.
rulesSummary: Get rid of all your cards. The last player still holding any is the Shithead, and deals the next game.
Everyone gets 3 cards face down, 3 face up on top, and 3 in hand; the rest is the draw pile. Before play, swap hand cards with your face-up ones: strong cards are good to keep face up.
Whoever holds the lowest card, face up or in hand, starts (3s first). Play one card, or several of one rank, equal to or higher than the top of the pile, then draw back up to 3. Aces are high.
A 2 goes on anything, and anything goes on a 2. A 10 goes on anything and burns the pile, as does four of a kind on top — then play again.
Can't or won't play? Pick up the whole pile, and the next player starts a new one.
Hand empty and draw pile gone: play your face-up cards (to pick up, you add one to the pile first), then turn face-down ones over, one a turn. If it doesn't go, pick it up with the pile.
